nodes.title: Song request · template & fields
widgets_values: Bright, catchy synth-pop: analog synth hooks, punchy drum machines, melodic bass, glassy arpeggios and a clean polished vocal with layered harmonies in the chorus. Glossy 1980s character with modern production, strong verse-chorus structure. Lyrics about neon nights, fleeting romance and chasing a feeling.

You are a composer, songwriter and producer preparing a song request for YuE2 and a matching FLUX.2 album cover.
Adapt the user's musical brief into exactly four completed sections, in this order:
[Style]
[Lyrics]
[Title]
[Image_Prompt]
Return no explanation, reasoning, code fence or extra top-level section. Each top-level heading occurs once. Section tags within Lyrics may repeat.

STYLE
Write a concise, coherent musical description, preferably a comma-separated line. Include the requested genre, language for vocals, vocal character, principal instruments, mood and groove. Include BPM, meter and key when requested; otherwise choose compatible details only when useful. Short natural sentences are also valid. This is musical conditioning, not a rigid tag vocabulary.
Keep the dominant identity clear. Preserve the user's genre, instrumentation, exclusions and degree of vocal presence. Prefer a few distinctive musical details over a long list of competing references. Do not include a MiniMax-style Global Metadata / Vocal Details / chronological Arrangement report. Do not put API instructions, model names, token budgets, ABC notation or a negative-prompt block here.

LYRICS
Use the actual words to sing, with structural tags on their own lines, for example [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro]. This is a readable convention, not a claim that the model enforces a closed tag list or case-sensitive section grammar. Separate sections with blank lines. Write out repeated sung words in full rather than '(repeat twice)'.
Create original, concrete imagery, natural stresses and a memorable hook appropriate to the requested language and musical style. Keep phrasing singable at the requested tempo. Avoid padding, stock rhymes, excessive syllables and redundant sections. Preserve supplied lyrics unless the user asks for rewriting; do not replace their meaning or silently translate them. Keep production directions, timestamps, translations, phonetic coaching and chord notation out of sung text. Preserve normal spelling and punctuation.
INSTRUMENTAL / NO-LYRICS RULE (takes priority over all vocal-writing and template-focus advice):
When the user selects instrumental, no lyrics, or an instrumental track, the final Style MUST explicitly include: instrumental, no sung or spoken words, no lead vocals, no backing vocals, no choir. Describe the melodic role with instruments, never a singer. Omit vocal language, singer gender, vocal hooks, chant, rap, spoken word, ad-libs, scat and vocal chops even if these survive in unrelated voice/language fields or a genre template. The instrumental selection overrides such inherited fields and supplied lyric examples.
The final Lyrics section MUST contain ONLY a short instrumental structure such as [Intro], [Instrumental], [Outro], each tag on its own line. Do not write lyric lines, prose directions, placeholder text, syllables, oh/ah/la, mm/hmm, or a repeated vocal refrain. Do not copy the title, description or Style into Lyrics. Never invent words or vocalizations to fill time. Do not add vocal section tags such as [Verse] or [Chorus] to an instrumental map.
Default to no human voice at all. Only when explicitly requested may Style allow quiet, wordless closed-mouth humming as a background texture; in that case replace the no-vocals wording with: instrumental-led, background closed-mouth humming only, no sung or spoken words, no open-vowel singing, no lead vocals, no choir. Still keep Lyrics tag-only: never transcribe humming. Humming is the maximum vocal presence permitted in instrumental mode.
For a vocal song explicitly requested as sparse, include words only in its intended vocal passages. The separate wordless-vocals mode may use requested vocalizations, but it must never override an instrumental selection. These are prompting constraints, not a guarantee that the audio model will never hallucinate a voice.

FORM AND LENGTH
Develop a plausible musical arc with contrast and a satisfying ending. Treat requested duration as a compositional target. max_duration is an upper bound, not a requested exact runtime. Do not invent a fixed seconds-per-section formula or pad the map with dozens of empty tags. If no length was specified, choose a conventional concise song form. An extended request may justify another developed verse, chorus or bridge, but every addition should serve the song.
Keep Style and Lyrics economical. The toolkit uses an estimated text budget; actual YuE2 tokenization, ABC planning and generated music share context. The native YuE2 node generates the ABC melody/chord plan; this LLM must not generate it.

TITLE AND COVER
After the musical concept and lyrics are complete, choose one short final title derived from them. Then write one cohesive square album-cover description inspired by the song, with a clear subject, composition, palette, atmosphere and lighting. Avoid artist imitation or unwanted lettering. The image description is for FLUX.2 only, not for the song model. End Image_Prompt with: No text, letters, words, numbers, symbols, logos, watermarks, labels, signage, or other written characters.

FINAL CHECK (silent)
Preserve explicit user choices and exclusions. Resolve conflicting generated details before answering. Check singability, coherent style, vocal/instrumental intent and the four-section output contract. For an instrumental, verify the explicit Style exclusions and delete every non-tag line from Lyrics; only explicitly requested background closed-mouth humming may remain in Style. Emit only the finished content.

nodes.title: LLM · In ComfyUI / Local app / Cloud
Selected song / artwork / FlashSR model check
Prompt & LLM (01 + 02)
widgets_values:
## Song request → LLM → parser

Choose where the LLM runs: In ComfyUI (GGUF), Local app / server, or Cloud service. Only relevant controls are shown. External: start the API server, Set API key if needed, then Find models. Cloud sends prompts to the provider and may incur charges.

The LLM generates fresh text on every queued execution; no session/seed helper is needed. Unload releases only integrated models; manage external app memory in that app. Manual route: LLM enabled=false and parser manual fields. See LLM_PROVIDERS.md.

nodes.title: FLUX.2 Cover (03)
widgets_values:
## Optional FLUX.2 artwork

Cover is controlled centrally in **00 · CHOOSE / Song model** (default ON). OFF skips the FLUX model download group, rendering, preview and cover file. Audio, tags and production records export without artwork.

Render: 1536 px. Embedded cover: 1024 px. Lower render size to save memory.

widgets_values_named.text:
## Optional FLUX.2 artwork

Use the ON / OFF switch below. ON renders and saves the cover. OFF skips the FLUX model download group and image computation; audio, tags and production records still export without artwork.

Render: 1536 px. Embedded cover: 1024 px. Lower render size to save memory. Keep this switch connected to both the model check and cover saver. No other image output should request this branch.

nodes.title: MiniMax Music 3 (04)
widgets_values:
## Generate music

Song model selects MiniMax or YuE2 and the matching settings. YuE2 generates ABC first, then music tokens, acoustic latents and 48 kHz audio. max_duration is a ceiling; generation may end earlier. Model filenames are editable on Generate song.

widgets_values_named.text:

nodes.title: Audio Enhancement (05)
widgets_values:
## Optional restoration A → F

Choose **Refinement** in 00 · CHOOSE / Song model. **Model default** means OFF for YuE2, ON for MiniMax; On/Off are manual overrides.

When enabled: Declip → PRE 10 kHz → FlashSR → crossover → HF repair → POST 19 kHz. When disabled: pass original audio directly to mastering and skip FlashSR downloads.

Mastering is independent and enabled by default. Its switch covers Auto-EQ, manual EQ, sample-rate preparation and compressor / LUFS / peak control.

widgets_values_named.text:
## Restoration A → F

Declip → PRE 10 kHz → FlashSR → crossover → HF repair → POST 19 kHz.

Stored crossover is FlashSR only. Select Original + FlashSR air explicitly for blending.

Continue in the MASTERING area below: independent Auto-EQ and manual EQ, selectable output rate, then compressor / LUFS / peak control. The former static loudness step is replaced.

nodes.title: Save & Release (06)
widgets_values:
## Outputs & reports

Original FLAC, release FLAC/MP3 and optional cover use central paths and tags. JSON waits for all saved artifacts; the prompt report feeds the JSON writer.

Disabled processing stages report **bypassed** and pass audio through. With Mastering OFF, release files retain the incoming sample rate.

The original saver may attenuate clipping according to its peak-handling policy. When Cover is ON, embedding means audio savers wait for artwork.

widgets_values_named.text:
## Outputs & reports

Original FLAC, release FLAC/MP3 and cover use central paths and tags from 01. JSON waits for all saved artifacts; the prompt report feeds that JSON writer.

The original saver may attenuate clipping according to its saved peak-handling policy.

Cover embedding means audio savers wait for artwork. A preview of generation is inside the MiniMax subgraph. Independent no-artwork processing is available in AudioEnhance.

nodes.title: Models & Folders
widgets_values:
## Start here

1. Choose **YuE2** (default) or MiniMax in 00 · CHOOSE / Song model.
2. Set Cover (ON), Refinement (model default: YuE2 OFF / MiniMax ON) and Mastering (ON).
3. Check model filenames, output folder and artist/album.
4. Choose your song brief and LLM provider; review settings and queue.

Only the selected music engine loads. Model check downloads missing selected weights when auto_download is ON (default). YuE2 requires native YuE2 nodes.

widgets_values_named.text:
## Start here

1. Choose YuE2 or MiniMax on Song model.
2. Check the selected model filenames, output folder and artist/album.
3. Choose your song brief and LLM provider.
4. Review model-specific settings and queue.

Only the selected music engine loads. Model check downloads missing selected song weights when auto_download is on (default). YuE2 requires native YuE2 nodes.

nodes.title: Mastering · independent controls
widgets_values:
## Mastering controls

Auto-EQ enabled: on by default; switch off to skip automatic tonal correction. Warm tilt is a creative choice, not a universal correction. Connect reference_audio for Reference track.

Manual EQ: edit its unlinked panel; bypass=true turns only manual EQ off. Auto-EQ has its own application node. Both can be off or on independently.

Output rate: 44100 default, 48000 selectable. This resample-only stage also runs with mastering bypassed. Master rate stays keep.

compressor_enabled=false disables compression while retaining LUFS / peak control. Master bypass=true disables all dynamics / loudness protection.

Start: unity manual EQ, Auto-EQ on, gentle 1.5:1 compression, -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP. Compare at matched loudness; presets cannot repair a poor mix.

nodes.title: Cover control
widgets_values:
Cover creation is controlled centrally in **00 · CHOOSE / Song model**.

Cover is enabled by default. Switching it off also skips the FLUX.2 model check/download.
